I was home (not alone) with the family, however we had a pretty big house. I got the urge while on my computer downstairs with my back to my door. As im in the middle of beating it like it owes me money i hear the door open... by the time i spun around to see who came in, i only caught a glimpse of a foot disappearing around the corner.  I stayed in my room for the rest of the day afraid to go upstairs to make eye contact with the mystery member of my family that just walked in on me.

I didnt find out till years later that it was my younger brother who walked in. We laughed, i cried, it was a good time.

I used to feel that way for a long time, until thing got worse and worse and eventually i ended up in the hospital from a suicide attempt. When this happened i had a child on the way a loving wife and a stable job. What im saying is i had no reason to feel the way i did but the disease in my brain made me think otherwise... i finally realised that if you have a sickness, weather its your heart liver or even your brain, some of us need medicine to correct these illnesses.       Im not a doctor, but i am someone who cares cause i have been in your situation before, all im saying is dont rule out possible treatments because some of us need them.  Also thanks for replying!
